text:
Alex Chen: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few concrete timeline Qs on API streaming, Console rollout features, and Optimize recommendations. can leadership confirm quarter windows so teams can plan?

Maria Gutierrez: thanks alex — can you scope hosted vs dedicated vs private for each? makes a difference for timelines. also are you asking about beta vs GA? cc @Jeff Park

Alex Chen: hosted first (public beta -> GA). then notes for Dedicated. private/on-prem can be a separate ticket. beta vs GA windows please.

Jeff Park: high-level answers: hosted API streaming public beta target = mid-Q3 2026; GA = late-Q4 2026. Console: rollouts UI (canaries, weights, automatic fallback) = experimental in Q3, broader beta in Q4. Optimize (recommendation engine for batching/quantization): alpha in late Q3, beta in early Q4, GA depends on initial telemetry (likely Q1 2027). these are target windows not hard commitments. :calendar:

Tina Rao: will the Console rollouts page expose per-route token cost estimations and a simple toggle for auto-fallback?

Jeff Park: yes — initial rollout will show per-route latency and per-1000-token cost estimate. auto-fallback will be a policy toggle (priority: latency | cost | reliability). default policy = latency-first with a 500ms threshold.

Samir Patel: engineering note: to hit mid-Q3 for streaming beta we need to freeze kernel/ops changes by end of May and have a 6-week dogfood period. model pinning + KV caching compatibility is blocked by one perf regression we're tracking.

Alex Chen: does that regression affect Dedicated timeline?

Samir Patel: Dedicated will lag ~6-8 weeks behind hosted for streaming GA because of infra mapping and capacity validation. private/on-prem will be even later (customer-driven).

Jordan (product): Optimize specifics — first pass will be suggestions only (UI + CLI) not an automatic optimizer. suggestions include: batching window (ms), kv-cache TTL, quantization profile (int8 / dynamic). we'll ship a sample eval suite so teams can see quality delta per suggestion.

Alex Chen: can we get those sample evals attached to the roadmap ticket so teams can preview?

Maria Gutierrez: yes — action: product to attach sample eval harness + suggested prompts by 2026-06-10. engineering to confirm kernel freeze date by 2026-05-24. launch comms and docs draft due 2026-07-15. I'll file follow-up tickets.

Jeff Park: a couple extra clarifications: streaming beta will support streaming responses + function/tool-call streaming. SDKs (python/js) will have streaming helpers in the beta SDKs.

Alex Chen: sample cURL example for folks who asked about the new stream endpoint:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-7b",
  "stream": true,
  "timeout_ms": 120000
}
```

Tina Rao: thanks — will product include rollout policy presets (5%, 20%, 50%) so PMs don't have to hand-type weights?

Jordan (product): yep — presets + a custom slider. also telemetry hooks for rollback triggers (error-rate, latency deviation).

Samir Patel: devops note: please expect a brief stability window during beta where we'll throttle non-prod traffic and prioritize customer-facing instances.

Alex Chen: action items recap (from thread):
- Product: attach sample eval harness + prompts by 2026-06-10 (Jordan / Maria)
- Eng: confirm kernel freeze date by 2026-05-24 and report the perf regression status (Samir)
- Docs/Comms: draft beta launch messaging by 2026-07-15 (Maria)
- PMs/Owners: review costs/telemetry presets and flag any blockers by 2026-05-30

Maria Gutierrez: I'll create a short follow-up doc and a shared board with milestones. thanks all — good thread. :rocket:
